answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond from a scarce, externally earned resource, then slash it when independent audits find duplicated control or fabricated work. A Sybil farm can mint names cheaply, but it cannot multiply the attacker’s real stake: every new identity needs capital locked up, and one detected lie can forfeit it. Keep reputation tied to completed tasks, not account age; an ivory vertex on a jetty may be memorable, but it is not proof of a distinct person.
